job_description:
TENAX has openings for Information Technology support services for the Office of Naval Intelligence. These are onsite, full time positions requiring Top Secret / SCI clearances, and IT certifications.

Software Developer, Systems Software researches, designs, develops, and tests operating systems-level software, compilers, and network distribution software for DoD and IC environments. Develop software applications IAW established functional, operational, and specification requirements. Set operational specifications and formulate and analyze software requirements.

Required Qualifications

• An active TS clearance with eligibility for TS/SCI is required.

• Bachelor’s degree or years of experience equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, information technology/systems or equivalent

• Have minimum of 5 years of experience developing in Java, JavaScript, SQL, and/or Python.

• Experience leading Agile Development Teams

• Experience in SDLC processes

• Experience in implementing and maintaining DevSecOps, and CI /CD pipelines.

Desired Qualifications

• 6 - 10 years of experience developing in Java, JavaScript and/or Python
